title_en: Come on, change your clothes, Tsare
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. 'Царе/Царо' is a pet name or a name of the addressed girl, my reading. 'робанчето' (little slave/servant boy, probably the musician) and 'да ги пукнам' (knock out / drive wild) and 'најпојќе' (most of all) are my guesses.

lines.cyr: Ајде промени се, Царе мори накити се,
lines.lat: Ajde promeni se, Care mori nakiti se,
lines.en: Come on, change your clothes, Tsare, hey, dress up,

lines.cyr: облечи си, Царо мори срмен елек.
lines.lat: obleči si, Caro mori srmen elek.
lines.en: put on, Tsaro, hey, a silver-embroidered vest.

lines.cyr: Ајде облечи си, Царе мори срмен елек
lines.lat: Ajde obleči si, Care mori srmen elek
lines.en: Come on, put on, Tsare, hey, a silver-embroidered vest
lacquered, Tsare, hey, shiny as mirrors.

lines.cyr: Ајде да излезиш, Царе мори на сред село,
lines.lat: Ajde da izleziš, Care mori na sred selo,
lines.en: Come on, come out, Tsare, hey, into the middle of the village,

lines.cyr: кај што свири, Царо мори робанчето.
lines.lat: kaj što sviri, Caro mori robančeto.
lines.en: where, Tsaro, hey, the little slave boy plays.

lines.cyr: Ајде да се фатиш, Царе мори на орото
lines.lat: Ajde da se fatiš, Care mori na oroto
lines.en: Come on, join, Tsare, hey, the oro,

lines.cyr: на орото, Царе мори карши мене.
lines.lat: na oroto, Care mori karši mene.
lines.en: the oro, Tsare, hey, opposite me.

lines.cyr: Ајде дигни очи, Царе мори погледај ме,
lines.lat: Ajde digni oči, Care mori pogledaj me,
lines.en: Come on, raise your eyes, Tsare, hey, look at me,

lines.cyr: скрши веѓи, Царо мори намигни ми.
lines.lat: skrši veǵi, Caro mori namigni mi.
lines.en: arch your brows, Tsaro, hey, wink at me.

lines.cyr: Ајде да ги пукнам, Царе мори ергените
lines.lat: Ajde da gi puknam, Care mori ergenite
lines.en: Come on, let me knock out, Tsare, hey, the bachelors,
and most of all, Tsare, hey, the grooms.
